K3_x_T2.note: chi(K3 x T2) = chi(K3) * chi(T2) = chi(K3) * 0 = 0, since T2 has vanishing Euler characteristic (it is a group manifold / has a nowhere-vanishing vector field); this is exact, not a numerical coincidence, and follows directly from Kunneth applied to the given Betti numbers.
